sections.label: 01  Privacy
paragraphs: This website is run by Eleven Sound LLC, 2255 Barry Avenue, Los Angeles, CA 90064.
We don’t collect anything through this site. If you email us, we use your name, email and message to reply, and that’s it. We never sell or share it.
Like every website, our host keeps basic technical logs (IP address, browser, pages visited) to keep the site running and secure.
You can ask what we hold about you, or ask us to correct or delete it: [privacy contact email].

sections.label: 02  Cookies & tracking
paragraphs: No cookies, no analytics. Your sound on or off choice stays in your browser until you close the tab.
Films play through Vimeo with tracking turned off. Links to Vimeo, Instagram and LinkedIn take you to sites with their own privacy policies.
We don’t track you across other sites, so every visit is treated the same, with or without a Do Not Track signal.

sections.label: 03  Use of this site
paragraphs: The films on this site are shown as examples of our work. They belong to their brands, agencies and directors, so please don’t download or reuse them.
Everything else, the design and the words, is ©2026 Eleven.
